<textarea id="stdinboxA">Stdin
Hello</textarea>

```python3:interactive:stdin-taid:stdinboxA:button-name:ReadStdin
def read_me():
    output = ""
    while True:
        try:
            output += input()
        except EOFError:
            break
    print(output)
read_me()
```

<input id="uploadboxA" type="file">

```python3:interactive:file-upload-id:uploadboxA:button-name:UploadPy
import os
files = [f for f in os.listdir() if f.endswith('.txt')]
if len(files) == 0:
    print("NoUploadFilesFound")
```

<script>
function mapC(s) {
    if (s.trim() === 'run this c') {
        return '#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void) { printf("MappedC"); return 0; }';
    }
    return 'int main(void){return 1;}';
}
</script>

```c:interactive:code-mapper:mapC:button-name:MapC
run this c
```

```c:interactive:max-output-length:10:button-name:TruncC
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 40000; i++) {
        printf("%d", i);
    }
    return 0;
}
```
